title: Power, toughness and mana value confused (17 cards)
body:
Toughness encoded as power: Catapult Captain, Abzan Beastmaster, Arbor Adherent, Bighorner Rancher, Flourishing Hunter, Towering Titan, Welcome to the Fold, The Wilds, Danse Macabre

Power encoded as toughness: Savage Swipe

Power encoded as mana value: Dread Defiler, Body Launderer

Mana value encoded as power: Death's Oasis, Soul Shatter, Flare of Malice (these two also omit planeswalkers)

Counting wrong: Ghalta and Mavren (#20), Communal Brewing subtracts its counters from the spell's mana value instead of using the count
